versions.changelog:
seedance-product-video 2.0.0

- Requires ofox-video-core 2.0.0 or newer; now passes `--approved` flag for all billable subcommands to enforce explicit approval before charges.
- Dropped support for older ofox-video-core versions; older cores will stop with a clear error if used.
- Updated documentation to clarify version requirement and flag behavior.
- Removed the outdated `skill-card.md` file.

- Bumped version to 1.17.2.
- Updated SKILL.md and metadata version references.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md documentation file.

seedance-product-video 1.16.1

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and CHANGELOG.md for clarity and version increment.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core logic or functionality; this release is documentation and cleanup only.

seedance-product-video 1.16.0

- Updated version identifiers in SKILL.md to 1.16.0.
- Removed legacy documentation file: skill-card.md.
- General documentation cleanup and modernization; no significant new features or breaking changes.
- No changes to core functionality or user-facing behavior.

## seedance-product-video 1.15.2

- Version bump: updated to 1.15.2.
- Documentation refresh: SKILL.md updated for accuracy and minor clarifications.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- No changes to feature set or external behavior.

seedance-product-video 1.15.1

- Version update from 1.15.0 to 1.15.1.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and CHANGELOG.md.

seedance-product-video 1.15.0

- Updated version and metadata to 1.15.0.
- Documentation improvements in SKILL.md for clarity and user guidance.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.

- Added instructions on resolving the location of the ofox-video-core skill before use.
- Updated references and guidance for multi-directory (LobeHub and other) setups in SKILL.md.
- Expanded explanation for handling core script resolution and actions if not found.
- Bumped version to 1.14.1.
- Removed the now-unneeded skill-card.md file.

seedance-product-video 1.13.0

- Adds detailed documentation (SKILL.md) clarifying scenario-specific requirements, usage, and defaults for clean e-commerce product videos.
- Outlines a structured creative brief with must-ask and conditional questions, focusing on product photo and platform aspect ratio.
- Reinforces strict separation from cinematic/mood advertising scenarios and excludes use for anything involving people or dialogue.
- Documents integration and dependency on ofox-video-core for API handling, key management, and video processing.
